css: .density-demo{max-width:420px;padding:16px;border:1px solid #bbb;border-radius:10px}.density-controls{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}.density-controls button{padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer}.density-demo ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}.density-demo li{border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}.density-demo li:last-child{border-bottom:0}.density-demo ul.compact li{padding:4px 10px}.density-demo ul.comfortable li{padding:14px 12px}.density-controls button[aria-pressed="true"]{font-weight:700;outline:2px solid currentColor}
